## PR review

**Blocker — confirmed:** The patch changes the log call but leaves `data.name.trim()` unchanged. A runtime probe of the patched code with `{"id":1,"name":null}` still throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'trim')`. The fix must handle null before that call. [change.patch](/tmp/instr-fixture-ZGyZk5/change.patch:10)

**Description gap — confirmed:** The patch replaces an existing `console.log` with `console.debug`; it does not add a separate log. [change.patch](/tmp/instr-fixture-ZGyZk5/change.patch:8)

The expected return value for a null name is unspecified. This checkout has no Git remote, so I could not check PR review threads or post an inline finding.
